channel.title: Whittier Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Whittier Daily News (whittierdailynews.com)

item.title: Strong winds expected across Southern California, high wind warning issued for LA County
item.description: Gusts up to 50 mph are possible in parts of Los Angeles County while breezy conditions develop across Orange, Riverside and San Bernardino counties through Friday, meteorologists said.

item.title: Whether primary ballots set aside in two Texas counties will be counted remains uncertain
item.description: Democrats in deeply blue Dallas County say their hopes are dwindling

item.title: Trump’s White House ballroom is too big, architect says, as 2nd panel prepares to vote on it
item.description: A federal commission meets Thursday to consider the 90,000-square-foot project and to vote on whether to approve it.

item.title: Lawsuits accuse industrial hygiene firms of sham inspections on homes damaged by Eaton fire
item.description: The suits allege insurance carriers are using the dubious inspections to lowball property owners trying to settle claims for their smoke-damaged houses.

item.title: Last 2 names of 6 US soldiers who died in Kuwait attack identified by the Pentagon
item.description: Four soldiers were previously identified by the Pentagon on Tuesday.

item.title: Dodgers have tested Ryan Ward’s patience as he waits for opportunity
item.description: Ward has had three successful seasons in Triple-A, even winning the Pacific Coast League MVP award in 2025, but he is still waiting to get the call from the Dodgers. He says he’s frustrated but not bitter.

item.title: Ally Sentnor’s goal propels USWNT past Canada in SheBelieves Cup
item.description: Sentnor scores off a corner kick from Rose Lavelle in the 55th minute, and the Americans hold on for a 1-0 win in Columbus, Ohio, their seventh consecutive shutout.

item.title: Hacienda Heights man charged with running illegal dog fights
item.description: Raymond Nunez, 53, is charged with buying, delivering and possessing animals for an animal fighting venture,

item.title: Cutter Gauthier, Ville Husso lead Ducks past Islanders
item.description: Gauthier scores two goals, Beckett Sennecke adds a goal and an assist and backup goalie Husso makes 42 saves, as the Ducks score five unanswered goals in a 5-1 win to split the season series with one of the Metropolitan Division’s top teams.

item.title: Clippers throttle Pacers, close in on elusive .500 mark again
item.description: Kawhi Leonard has 29 points, Bennedict Mathurin scores 20 against his former team, and Darius Garland adds 12 points and eight assists in his first home game as the Clippers roll to a 130-107 win.
